propositions: Three diagnostic artifact files (transcript markdown, transcript driver, matrix driver) exist only on impl-10ae-verifier-ctx branch and are not ancestors of origin/main, rendering the ticket unverifiable against main.

The diagnostic scripts are reusable, parameterized tools that depend only on stable surfaces (pai_tools, completion._VERIFY_MIN_STEPS) and the budget-anchoring matrix should be re-runnable against future verifier step-floor changes.

The completion-verifier enters redundant tool-call loops when given surplus budget beyond convergence threshold (~100 calls for 25-request tickets), spending extra budget on re-reading before the runaway guard catches it.
Step-floor scaling (floor 50, 240, 480 req budget 25, 120, 240) confirms verifier converges around 6 steps per criterion but does not stop when given more budget than needed.

Runaway loops clustered on TEST-INFRASTRUCTURE tickets with import-machinery criteria lacking single obvious anchors, pointing to context pre-selection rather than guard effectiveness as remediation direction.
